1042.rule: a packet arm's invalid actions DOMINATE a seed when invalid_actions >= 0.5 x that arm's decision points in that seed (decision points = the total number of ticks the arm's episodes took in that seed); recorded per seed, and under this drive it is RECORDED ONLY — GF-3r-d's readings are taken on all seeds

claim_scope: the DRIVE PROBE at 230M on five bridges trained in process per seed across THREE rng streams (G1's goal+constant pair by G6's recipe, the goal bridge discarded; GF's focus+constant pair on a freshly re-seeded stream by GF's recipe, the focus bridge discarded; and a goal-exchange constant trained FIRST on a third freshly re-seeded stream): the chain's goal line through G6's latent prefix, and on the bus either NO packet at all (the hooks are not armed) or exactly ONE unmixed constant packet at dose 0.15; 3 bridge seed(s) x 10 eval chains x 4 arms. What is measured is WHICH property of the drive bridge the zero-shot prefix door needs — the exchange, the stream position, or none. No focus packet, no mix, no lean and no grip exist under this drive. Nothing here cites GS.

decision_rules.arms: prefix-nopacket is the latent prefix with NO packet (the hooks are not armed at all); prefix-g1const, prefix-gfconst and prefix-goalfirst each carry ONE unmixed constant packet at the trained delivery dose 0.15
decision_rules.breakdown: a packet arm's invalid actions DOMINATE a seed when invalid_actions >= 0.5 x that arm's decision points in that seed (decision points = the total number of ticks the arm's episodes took in that seed); recorded per seed, and under this drive it is RECORDED ONLY — GF-3r-d's readings are taken on all seeds
decision_rules.i_drive_not_needed: pooled success_rate(prefix-nopacket) >= 0.90 — the prefix door stands alone and GF's constant actively hurts; Miso-scale resident-want designs drop the drive packet or validate it
decision_rules.ii_exchange: pooled success_rate(prefix-nopacket) < 0.80 AND pooled success_rate(prefix-goalfirst) >= 0.90 — the door needs a drive and ANY goal-exchange drive will do
decision_rules.iii_position: pooled success_rate(prefix-goalfirst) <= 0.70 — the drive must have been trained BEHIND a goal bridge; the pair, not the bridge, is the object
decision_rules.iv_mixed: none of the above: prefix-goalfirst lands between the two references, recorded with the number
decision_rules.order: (i) first, on the ALL-SEED pooled prefix-nopacket success — the registration calls arm 1 the decisive cell; then (ii), then (iii), then (iv) MIXED as the residue. The reference checks on prefix-g1const and prefix-gfconst are ALWAYS reported and never gate the reading
decision_rules.reference_checks: GF-3r-g1 measured prefix-only over G1's constant at 1.00 pooled and over GF's at 0.63 pooled on exactly these bridges; this run reproduces a reference when its pooled rate is within 0.10 of that number. A failed reference check does not change the reading — it is reported beside it, because a run that does not reproduce them is measuring something else
decision_rules.source: the registration states readings (i)-(iv) in prose; these thresholds are THIS HARNESS's operationalization of that prose and are recorded and printed rather than hidden

injection_placement.armed_by: relay_experiment.relay_injection -> MultiResidualInjection, one ResidualInjection per inject layer, position=-1, once=False, mode 'conditioned', layers [4, 6, 8]
injection_placement.bank_offsets: 0 on the last prefill position, then 1, 2, ... per generated token, clamped at delta_positions-1 = 15; __enter__ resets the counter, so every generate call starts at 0
injection_placement.decode_steps: each KV-cached step takes start=0 over its single new position, so every generated token is injected
injection_placement.effect_of_prefix_length: P shifts the ABSOLUTE index of the injection point by exactly P and changes nothing else: not the relative placement (always the last prefill position), not the bank-offset schedule, not the count of injected positions
injection_placement.identical_across_arms: the four arms differ only in the payload; the prefix is one cached tensor per chain, reused by every arm, so P is a property of the chain alone and the placement is identical across arms by construction
injection_placement.mix_is_inside_the_delta: no mix: GF-3r-d's arms carry an UNMIXED constant packet or no packet at all, so the hook is handed the constant bridge's own delivered payload at the trained dose 0.15 in the three packet arms and no hook is armed at all in prefix-nopacket
injection_placement.prefill_position_meaning: the LAST token of the rendered chat prompt (the generation-prompt tail); positions 0..P-1 (the entire goal prefix) and P..P+L-2 are NOT injected
injection_placement.prefix_text_rule: g6_splitdoor.installed_goal_line(chain['item']) — G6's prefix verbatim, embedded through model.get_input_embeddings(); note GF-3 at 27B appended '\n\n' to the goal line and G6 did not, and the registration pins G6's mechanism
injection_placement.read_from: mom_bridge.ResidualInjection._hook (mode 'conditioned'): the zero-dose early return, the start index and bank offsets under 'positional'/'conditioned', and __enter__'s reset of next_offset
injection_placement.zero_dose: at fraction 0.0 the hook returns the layer output before it reads the residual — the property gates (a) and (b) test

protocol.drive_note: FIVE bridges per seed on THREE rng streams. Stream 1 is G1's: g6_splitdoor.run_g6's block verbatim, goal bridge first (trained only to place the rng, then discarded) and constant bridge second — GF-3r-g1's own G1 constant. protocol.note: four prefix-only arms x the eval chains, budget 8, every episode carrying the chain's goal line in the latent prefix. prefix-nopacket arms NO hook at all (the payload handed to the generate call is None, so gf3_27b.generate_prefixed_with_packet takes sb._NullContext) and is the decisive cell and the paired baseline; the other three each deliver ONE unmixed constant packet at the trained dose 0.15. rules.arms: prefix-nopacket is the latent prefix with NO packet (the hooks are not armed at all); prefix-g1const, prefix-gfconst and prefix-goalfirst each carry ONE unmixed constant packet at the trained delivery dose 0.15

rules.i_drive_not_needed: pooled success_rate(prefix-nopacket) >= 0.90 — the prefix door stands alone and GF's constant actively hurts; Miso-scale resident-want designs drop the drive packet or validate it
rules.ii_exchange: pooled success_rate(prefix-nopacket) < 0.80 AND pooled success_rate(prefix-goalfirst) >= 0.90 — the door needs a drive and ANY goal-exchange drive will do
rules.iii_position: pooled success_rate(prefix-goalfirst) <= 0.70 — the drive must have been trained BEHIND a goal bridge; the pair, not the bridge, is the object
rules.iv_mixed: none of the above: prefix-goalfirst lands between the two references, recorded with the number
rules.order: (i) first, on the ALL-SEED pooled prefix-nopacket success — the registration calls arm 1 the decisive cell; then (ii), then (iii), then (iv) MIXED as the residue. The reference checks on prefix-g1const and prefix-gfconst are ALWAYS reported and never gate the reading
rules.reference_checks: GF-3r-g1 measured prefix-only over G1's constant at 1.00 pooled and over GF's at 0.63 pooled on exactly these bridges; this run reproduces a reference when its pooled rate is within 0.10 of that number. A failed reference check does not change the reading — it is reported beside it, because a run that does not reproduce them is measuring something else
rules.source: the registration states readings (i)-(iv) in prose; these thresholds are THIS HARNESS's operationalization of that prose and are recorded and printed rather than hidden
